evals.prompt: Prepare a dry-run OpenVINO inference stress plan for a 30-second CPU run using the default model and automatic runtime detection. Do not launch a pod/container or download a model. Show the resolved command, preconditions, confirmation gate, and what would be verified after launch.
evals.expected_output: Provide a Planned Load table, validated parameters, fail-closed runtime/model prerequisites, dry-run confirmation outcome, and post-launch verification/cleanup commands without claiming a workload is running.
expectations: Resolves CPU, duration=30, niter=0, sync API, the default model, and automatic runtime detection
Lists runtime, script, Intel/x86, model, and input validation, including the documented model auto-download dependency
Renders the Planned Load table before confirmation and builds the absolute command with duration rather than niter
States that dry-run/declined confirmation prevents launch and names pod/container status, logs, and stop commands as post-launch checks
Includes ephemeral workload cleanup and does not claim a pod/container or model download exists
